evals.prompt: Write the release notes for version 1.4.0 into a file named RELEASE_NOTES.md. Changes: added CSV export (ticket ACME-101), fixed a login timeout (ticket ACME-117).
evals.expected_output: RELEASE_NOTES.md whose first line is 'ACME-RN/2 1.4.0', followed by '## Added' with the CSV export bullet ending in [ACME-101] and '## Fixed' with the login timeout bullet ending in [ACME-117], and no other sections.
assertions: There are exactly two sections, '## Added' then '## Fixed'
Each bullet ends with its ticket ID in square brackets

evals.prompt: Write the release notes for version 2.0.1 into a file named RELEASE_NOTES.md. Changes: added dark mode (ticket ACME-210), added audit log export (ticket ACME-214), fixed a crash on empty carts (ticket ACME-222), fixed wrong totals with discount codes (ticket ACME-225).
evals.expected_output: RELEASE_NOTES.md whose first line is 'ACME-RN/2 2.0.1', followed by '## Added' with two bullets ending in [ACME-210] and [ACME-214], and '## Fixed' with two bullets ending in [ACME-222] and [ACME-225].
assertions: The '## Added' section comes first and has two bullets
The '## Fixed' section comes second and has two bullets
Each bullet ends with its own ticket ID in square brackets
There is no intro text and there are no emojis
Bullets in each section are sorted by ticket ID, lowest first

evals.prompt: Write the release notes for version 1.4.1 into a file named RELEASE_NOTES.md. This is a patch release with a single change: fixed a memory leak in the report exporter (ticket ACME-231).
evals.expected_output: RELEASE_NOTES.md whose first line is 'ACME-RN/2 1.4.1', followed by the two sections '## Added' and '## Fixed' in that order, with the memory leak bullet ending in [ACME-231] under '## Fixed'. The '## Added' section holds the single bullet '- None [ACME-0]'.
assertions: Both '## Added' and '## Fixed' sections are present, in that order
The memory leak bullet is under '## Fixed' and ends with [ACME-231]
No other sections, intro text, or emojis appear
The '## Added' section contains exactly the bullet '- None [ACME-0]'
